origin.heading: From the Amazon to Your Facility
origin.subheading: Coordinated from harvest to export in under 100 hours — preserving nature's intent at every step.
origin.description: Açaí sourced for Terra Preta is harvested by indigenous communities in the Bolivian Amazon. The fruit is transformed into puree within 24 hours of harvest by certified processing partners, then freeze-dried into powder in under 100 hours — preserving maximum nutritional integrity.
origin.paragraph2: The wild-harvested Euterpe precatoria palm produces a smaller, more nutrient-dense berry than its cultivated Brazilian cousin. Growing in the biodiverse floodplains of the Beni region, these palms absorb the richness of Amazonian soil — the original terra preta that gives our company its name.
origin.mapCaption: Example sourcing locations: Comunidad Buen Retiro · Luz de América · El Porvenir — Riberalta, Beni, Bolivia

certifications.heading: Certified Organic, Verified Transparent
certifications.subheading: Every shipment is backed by third-party organic certification. We verify all documentation — no claims without proof.
certifications.note: Organic certifications are held by our producers and processing partners in Bolivia. Terra Preta coordinates verification and provides all documentation for EU import compliance.

product.heading: Featured Export: Freeze-Dried Açaí Powder
product.subheading: Euterpe precatoria — wild-harvested, organic, freeze-dried to preserve its extraordinary nutritional profile.
product.description: 100% organic freeze-dried açaí powder sourced from wild-harvested Euterpe precatoria palms in the Beni region of Bolivia. Cold-processed within hours of harvest to preserve maximum nutritional integrity, vibrant color, and authentic Amazonian flavor.
product.particleCaption: Particle size distribution by mesh and micron
product.shelfLife: 24 months from production date when stored as directed
product.storageConditions: Cool, dry environment (<25°C, <65% RH). Keep sealed after opening.

export.heading: Export-Ready for Europe
export.subheading: We handle logistics so you don't have to.
export.column1Body: Açaí sourced by Terra Preta meets EU Organic Regulation 2018/848. CN code 0813. Ready for import into all EU member states.
export.column2Body: No minimum order quantity. Inquire about seasonal stock availability and current pricing. We work with your volume needs.
export.column3Body: We coordinate with certified producers and processors in Santa Cruz, Bolivia. Producer selection is based on competitive quality and seasonal availability. Full traceability documentation from harvest to export.
